code:
NUMA: multi-socket, local memory banks

SQL Server's scheduler is NUMA-aware
by default -- no sp_configure switch
needed to "turn it on."

Soft-NUMA: splits one large physical
node into smaller logical nodes --
a real, narrow lever on high-core boxes.
caption: Mostly automatic -- but per-node PLE (Lesson 31) can still hide a local problem.

code:
SELECT wait_type, waiting_tasks_count,
       wait_time_ms,
       wait_time_ms * 1.0 / waiting_tasks_count
         AS avg_wait_ms
FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats
WHERE wait_type LIKE 'PAGEIOLATCH%'
  AND waiting_tasks_count > 0;
caption: Average wait per wait -- not the total -- is what points at storage latency.
